message.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.b_cant: The Cravada needs you free and on the ground (not flying, swimming or stunned).

power.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.desc: Illusions, the strongest Kido, spiritual pressure and the Hogyoku's evolution.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rubber_boy.4.de:
Only with the Drums of Liberation full: Gear 5 for 1 minute, every move in its G5 version.

Press B again: become giant.

At the end: hunger and no stamina for a while.
message.battlegroundsmod.luffy.fome_on: Gear 5 is over: starving, no stamina
power.battlegroundsmod.rubber_boy.desc: H climbs a Gear (G2, G3, G4), Shift+H goes down. Z/X/C/V come out in the Gear that's on. Gears last 30 s in total, then recharge. Drums of Liberation full: B turns Gear 5 for 1 minute, then hunger and no stamina.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rubber_boy.0.de:
A stretched punch from afar.

Comes out in the Gear that's on (H): G2 Jet, G3 Gigant, G4 Kong Gun.

Stuns from G3 up.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rubber_boy.1.de:
A barrage of punches that keeps the target in front of you.

Comes out in the Gear that's on (H): G2 Jet, G3 Elephant, G4 Kong Organ.

From G2 up, the last punch stuns.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rubber_boy.2.de:
Both palms throw the target far.

Comes out in the Gear that's on (H): G2 Jet, G3 Grizzly, G4 Leo.

Stuns from G2 up.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rubber_boy.3: Rifle (Gear: Jet Dive, Fusen, King Kong Gun)
ability.battlegroundsmod.rubber_boy.3.de:
A spinning punch that stuns.

Comes out in the Gear that's on (H): G2 Jet Dive (falls punching from above), G3 Fusen (balloon that bounces the hit back), G4 King Kong Gun.
power.battlegroundsmod.one_punch.desc: Strong, fast normal blows, and not even a stun stops his fists. Fill the Serious Bar and press V: each key becomes a serious move.
ability.battlegroundsmod.one_punch.0.des:
30 punches in 1 s. The wind hits whoever is up to 8 blocks behind the target; the last punch throws far.

Serious Mode: one punch that opens a 200 block trench. Ends the mode.
ability.battlegroundsmod.one_punch.1.des:
Uppercut: the target flies 30 blocks and loses whatever it was charging.

Serious Mode: a punch on the ground. Whoever goes up with the rocks takes 50 punches from every side.
ability.battlegroundsmod.one_punch.2.des:
A wind kick along the ground (16 blocks): breaks guard and drags the target.

Serious Mode: flips a huge slab of ground like a table.
ability.battlegroundsmod.one_punch.4.des:
Counter. Works while being comboed.

The next hit is caught with one hand and a flick sends the attacker far.
ability.battlegroundsmod.one_punch.5.des:
A punch at the air: a fist of wind flies 25 blocks and takes whoever is in the way.

Good against runners.
ability.battlegroundsmod.one_punch.7.des:
Leaps up to 24 blocks where you aim and punches the ground.

The cracks run 15 blocks and explode, launching everyone up.
message.battlegroundsmod.opm.serio_on: Serious Mode: 3 serious moves in 20 s (the Serious Punch ends it)
ability.battlegroundsmod.one_punch.3.des:
With the Serious Bar full: Serious Mode for 20 s. Each key becomes a serious move (3 per mode).

In the mode, V is the Serious Sneeze (300 blocks).
message.battlegroundsmod.boss_debug_on: Boss thoughts shown on the action bar.

message.battlegroundsmod.teleport_no_tar: No target within %s blocks: aim at one or hit one first
message.battlegroundsmod.teleport_blocke: No room in front of the target

ability.battlegroundsmod.destruction_god:
Hold to charge the sphere, release to throw it.

It homes in on the target (no target: follows your aim) and explodes into a crater.

Flick and slap: the target flies and is slammed into the ground.

Stunned and sealed until out of the hole (2.5 s).

Combo: right after, Shift+C.

Hold: the sphere forms on your finger.

Release: it flies straight following your aim, becomes a giant sun and explodes where it hits.

Target at 20% life or less: erased, nothing saves it.

Above that: a Hakai ball chases the target through anything, traps it and explodes.
Rises and drops a tiny white ball: the ground explodes in a giant radius, pulverizing everything.

Rises untouchable and fires a rain of spheres at the target.

A strong stun cancels it.

Only on a stunned or exhausted target (use X first).

Takes the target to space and sends it back falling with the sphere on top: explosion and crater.

A spark that flies straight through everything: erases blocks and even attacks in the air.

Anyone at 20% life or less is erased.
Fire from the mouth in a cone. Burns and slows.

You can aim while breathing it.
Catches whoever is in front of you: stuns, blinds and seals their skills for 5 s.

Combo: right after, drop the Meteor (V).
2 s counter. Works even while stunned.

Whoever hits you up close is grabbed by the Susanoo, crushed and thrown (1.5 s stun).
A giant meteor falls where you aim, about 4 s later. Huge damage and a crater.

Tip: lock the target first (X or B) so it can't run.
A fast dash (up to 40 blocks).

If it lands: grabs the neck and slams them into the ground. They stay stuck in the hole for 2.5 s.
Jumps and stops in the air.

Hold: the fireball grows.

Release: throws it where you aim. More charge, more damage.
Records 30 s around you. Meanwhile nobody on your side dies, but you can't use skills.

At the end everything goes back: enemies keep their wounds and your cooldowns reset.

Once per life.
The Susanoo's sword throws a huge slash where you aim, splitting blocks and enemies.
Two meteors fall one after the other where you aim.
gamerule.passivakokushibo.description: Off, Kokushibo (player and boss) gets no day/night buffs or debuffs and no Night Vision: weak regeneration and normal strength all the time.
gamerule.soulsDesativarVoo.description: On, no player can fly anywhere in the world: the Voo, Gaara's sand platform and any other flight from the mod. Anyone in the air glides down. Creative and spectator still fly.
gamerule.soulsBlockDestruction.descripti: When off, no skill or boss from the mod breaks or changes blocks. Effects and damage stay. mobGriefing off also stops it.
gamerule.soulbotscaoticos.description: On: bots and bosses drop their strategy and fight in chaos: much faster decisions, no waiting, almost random moves, short warnings, always running, random dodges, jumps, dashes and blinks. Cooldowns, stuns and human reaction stay the same.
gamerule.allbossestier0.description: On: bosses a player spawns (egg, /summon, dispenser) are Tier 0 with the same health, armor and damage. Challenges, Dungeon and world bosses don't change.
power.battlegroundsmod.strongest.desc: Throughout heaven and earth, he alone is the honored one.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.0.des:
Press Z: the Blue locks where you aim and pulls enemies for 6 s.

Hold Z: it grows. Release and it follows your aim for 10 s, ripping out blocks.

While it is out: mouse scroll pushes it away or pulls it closer. Press Z again to lock or unlock it. Hold Z to shoot it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.1.des:
A straight wall of repulsion where you aim: throws far and digs a tunnel.

Hold to charge: goes much farther and wider.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.2.des:
Hold: the Purple forms in 5 s and grows.

Release: flies straight erasing everything in its path.

Unlimited Purple: lock a full Blue and hit it with a full Red (explodes 100 blocks).
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.3.des:
Domain: everyone around is paralyzed until it breaks. Inside, only you can attack.

Ends when the target dies or you fall.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.5.des:
Pulls the target you aim at (up to 50 blocks) to you.

Then a guaranteed Black Flash: high damage, crater and launch.
message.battlegroundsmod.azul_flash_no_t: Aim at someone to pull them with the Blue.
message.battlegroundsmod.vermelho_no_tar: Aim at someone to appear behind them.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.6.des: Appears behind the target you aim at and fires the Red point blank.
item.battlegroundsmod.byakuya_spawn_egg: Captain of the Sixth Spawn Egg
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.0.d:
Hold: the box closes on the target, who stays locked while you hold.

Release: the lances pierce whoever is inside.

In the Hōgyoku form it is bigger and stronger.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.1.d:
A clone stays in your place and you turn invisible for up to 7 s. Mobs go after the clone.

Press X again (or someone hits the clone): it breaks and you show up.

The cooldown only starts when it breaks.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.2.d:
A golden bolt runs to where you look.

Stuns whoever is on the line and explodes where it lands, opening a crater.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.3.d:
You close in a cocoon (nobody can hurt you) and come out evolved for 40 s: stronger, faster, tougher.

In the form: full Black Box, V throws the Fragor and Shift+V casts Hadō 99.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.4.d:
0.6 s counter. Works even while stunned.

Close hit: you appear behind them and cut (1.5 s stun).

Technique or projectile: a wall blocks everything from that side.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.6.d:
A short blue fire that follows your aim. You can walk while casting.

Burns, pushes and stuns for a moment.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.8.d:
Only in the Hōgyoku form, once per form.

Five dragons fall together where you look: huge damage and a giant crater.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.9.d:
Hold: the pressure grows around you (up to 25 blocks) and pins everyone inside, no attacks or skills.

Release: it explodes. The longer you held, the stronger.
message.battlegroundsmod.aizen_hado99_fo: The Hado 99 only works in the Hogyoku form
message.battlegroundsmod.aizen_hado99_us: Hado 99 already used in this form
message.battlegroundsmod.hogyoku: Hogyoku Evolution: V again = Fragor, Shift+V = Hado 99
message.battlegroundsmod.stamina_out: Out of stamina! Vulnerable for %s s
message.battlegroundsmod.needs_stun: The target must be stunned (hit it with a stun or drain its stamina).
message.battlegroundsmod.domain_resist: Infinite information! Your stamina is holding off the Domain...
message.battlegroundsmod.domain_escaped: You got out of the Domain!
message.battlegroundsmod.shrine_resist: The Shrine caught you! Your stamina is holding off the cuts...
message.battlegroundsmod.technique_burno: Burnt-out technique: no techniques for %s s
message.battlegroundsmod.duel_tie_gojo: Tie! The Shrine is cracking your barrier from outside. Press V to reopen it (heavy stamina)
message.battlegroundsmod.duel_tie_sukuna: Tie! The sure hits cancel out: break his barrier from outside
message.battlegroundsmod.duel_reopen_sta: Not enough stamina to reopen the Void
power.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.desc: Low Soul from Bleach. Controlled blades: a thousand petals that cut whatever he wants.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.0.desc:
Hold: a river of petals runs along your aim (32 blocks, up to 5 s) cutting everything in the way.

In Bankai it goes farther and cuts more.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.1.desc:
The petals close a sphere on the target you aim at and crush it. Never misses.

Hits harder in Bankai.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.2.desc: Appears behind the target and cuts twice: 2.5 s stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.3.desc:
Turns on Bankai: a storm of petals follows you and cuts whoever gets close.

Press V again: rings of swords close on the target.

Shift+V: the finisher.
power.battlegroundsmod.rukia.desc: Low Soul from Bleach. Zones of ice.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.0.desc: A circle on the ground where you aim: whoever is inside freezes solid and then shatters.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.1.desc:
Stabs the sword 4 times and releases an 18 block ice avalanche that freezes everything in its way.

Then it shatters (2nd hit).
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.2.desc:
The blade stretches 17 blocks.

Pierced someone: ice spreads over them.

Hit the ground: leaves a spike for 8 s that freezes whoever touches it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.3.desc:
You freeze solid: anyone within 10 blocks, or who touches you, turns to ice and shatters.

At the end you are vulnerable for a moment.
item.battlegroundsmod.soul_insect.tip1: Eat it once: you never go hungry again
item.battlegroundsmod.soul_insect.tip2: Hunger always full; out of combat mode it slowly heals your life (permanent passive)
message.battlegroundsmod.teleport_domain: Can't teleport into or out of a Domain Expansion
message.battlegroundsmod.teleport_locked: Teleport locked: beat %s challenges from the Challenge Book (%s/%s)
message.battlegroundsmod.teleport_progre: Teleport: %s/%s challenges from the Challenge Book
message.battlegroundsmod.teleport_unlock: Double tap Ctrl while aiming at an enemy to appear right next to them.
message.battlegroundsmod.soul_insect.eat: The Soul Insect lives in you now: you will never go hungry again
message.battlegroundsmod.soul_insect.alr: Your soul already carries a Soul Insect
advancements.battlegroundsmod.soul_insec: Eat a Soul Insect and never go hungry again
power.battlegroundsmod.goku.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 6 (Continental). Pure ki: beams, teleport and the Kaioken, always past the limit.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.0.desc:
Hold to charge.

Release: the beam fires. Keep holding and it thickens, pushes the target and explodes at the end.

Bigger with Kaioken.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.1.desc: Vanishes and appears behind the target you aim at, already punching: 2 s stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.2.desc:
Press C: the Kaioken flares up and you appear on the aimed target (up to 20 blocks).

Stuns at once, 4 fast hits from different sides and a kick that launches.

With B's Kaioken on, the kick turns it off.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.3.desc:
Hold to gather the Spirit Bomb (up to 60 s; full, it kills in one hit).

Release: it falls slowly where you aim and opens a crater.
power.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.desc:
Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 6 (Continental). The proud prince: endless barrages, the Galick Gun and the Final Flash.

Passive Zenkai: survive under 20% life and your blows deal +15% damage until you die.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.0.desc:
Hold: nonstop ki shots.

The smoke covers the target and blinds it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.1.desc: A big ki ball that chases the target and explodes. Quick charge and flight.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.2.desc:
Hold: gather purple ki between your hands, walking slowly.

Release early: a thin quick beam. Charged (up to 2 s): a thick beam that tears the ground, pushes and explodes at the end.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.3.desc: Gathers energy standing still (exposed) and fires a giant beam that goes through everything and tears the ground.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.4.desc:
Dash at the target (up to 12 blocks): stomach punch, 4 punches, uppercut, vanish, a hammer that drives it into the ground and a point-blank ki ball.

A raised guard at the start parries and breaks the rush.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.8.desc:
Blows up everything around (radius 35, huge damage).

The price: you turn to stone and die right after.
message.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.impact_n: Galick Impact: aim at someone within %s blocks.
power.battlegroundsmod.freeza.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 6 (Continental). Elegant cruelty: piercing fingers, telekinesis and the Death Ball.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.0.desc: Hold: up to 6 thin beams from the finger that pierce whoever is on the line.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.1.desc:
Hold: the target follows your aim, limp as a rag doll.

Drag it fast into a wall: it breaks through block by block. Pull it down: crushed. Along the ground: it digs a furrow. Let go: it falls.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.2.desc:
A disc chases the target and comes back. Careful: it cuts you too if you don't dodge.

Press C again: blows it up in the air.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.3.desc: A huge sphere grows on the finger and falls slowly where you aim, with a big explosion.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.4.desc:
Holds whoever you aim at (up to 25 blocks), lifts them 7 blocks and blows them up in the sky.

Finishing: they rise much higher and the blast is giant.
message.battlegroundsmod.freeza.psycho_n: Death Psycho Bomb: aim at someone within %s blocks.
power.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 7 (City). The strategist: a ray that pierces everything, a stretching arm and ki traps.
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.0.desc: A short thick beam that pushes the target and explodes on it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.1.desc:
The arm stretches 17 blocks, pulls the target and knees it: 2 s stun.

A front guard blocks it.

Combo: right after, C.
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.2.desc:
Only on a stunned target (use X first). The slot lights up when it's ready.

20 ki balls surround the target, which stays locked.

Press C again (or wait 4 s): they all explode on it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.3.desc:
Hold to charge and release: a thin beam pierces everyone on the line up to 68 blocks.

More charge, more damage.
power.battlegroundsmod.kame.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 7 (City). The old master: looks weak and silly, but wears anyone out.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.0.desc:
For 4 s you dodge 60% of close hits ("Dodge!" shows up) and answer with a palm strike.

Press Z again: the palm strike right away.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.1.desc:
You bulk up: punches 40% stronger.

Press X again (or wait 3 s): fires the Max Kamehameha and you go back to normal.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.2.desc:
Two bolts hold the target for 2 s and it ends up stunned. A front guard blocks it.

Combo: right after, V.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.3.desc:
Only on a stunned target (use C first). The slot lights up when it's ready.

Seals the target in a jar: at 10% life or less it dies, otherwise it breaks out hurt.

Then you are out of stamina.
power.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 8 (Block). The weakest of the group, but the smartest: discs that cut everything and a blinding flash.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.0.desc:
A disc that cuts for very high damage, and cuts blocks too.

Hold until it forms: throws two.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.1.desc:
Blinds whoever is facing you (12 blocks): 3 s stun and mobs lose their target.

Whoever had their back turned escapes. A hit from the front wakes them.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.2.desc: The ball rises where you aim and splits into 14 beams that rain on enemies around.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.3.desc:
A bigger disc.

After throwing, hold the key: it turns where you look, cutting one target after another.
message.battlegroundsmod.db.skill_coming: This skill is still being made in the Visualizer. Coming in a next version!
message.battlegroundsmod.goku.tele_no_ta: Instant Transmission: aim at someone within %s blocks.
message.battlegroundsmod.goku.kaioken_li: Kaioken: the body hit its limit and it switched off.
message.battlegroundsmod.goku.rush_no_ta: Kaioken Rush: aim at someone within %s blocks.
message.battlegroundsmod.freeza.tele_no_: Telekinesis: aim at someone within %s blocks.
message.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.hellzon: Hellzone Grenade: aim at someone within %s blocks.
Hellzone Grenade: the target must be stunned (use the Stretched Arm first).
message.battlegroundsmod.kame.shock_no_t: Bankoku Bikkuri Sho: aim at someone within %s blocks.
message.battlegroundsmod.kame.palm_no_ta: Palm: nobody close in front of you.
message.battlegroundsmod.kame.mafuba_no_: Mafuba: aim at someone within %s blocks.
message.battlegroundsmod.kame.mafuba_nee: Mafuba: the target must be stunned (use the Bankoku Bikkuri Sho first).
message.battlegroundsmod.kame.sealed: You were sealed in the Mafuba jar!
message.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.taiyoke: Solar Flare: nobody was looking at you.
item.battlegroundsmod.freeza_spawn_egg: Emperor of the Universe Spawn Egg
power.battlegroundsmod.naruto.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 6 (Continental). Loud and stubborn: clones everywhere, a Rasengan to the face and Sage Mode.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.0.desc:
Runs up to 18 blocks and drives the Rasengan in: stuns and launches far.

Twice the size with clones alive.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.1.desc:
Three clones appear and fight on their own (die in 1 hit).

Press X again: you swap with the clone closest to the target and punch from behind.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.2.desc: Four clones kick the target up and you come down with a heel drop, slamming it down with a stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.3.desc:
Meditates 3 s (getting hit breaks it). For 30 s your punches reach farther and hit harder.

Press V again: throws the Rasenshuriken.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.4.desc:
Trap (up to 2): a clone turns into a rock where you aim.

When an enemy walks by, Naruto jumps out from behind with a Rasengan.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.9.desc:
Throws a clone shaped as a shuriken (32 blocks).

Hit or dodged: it turns into Naruto and lands a Rasengan.
power.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 6 (Continental). Cold and precise: burns with the Katon, reads the enemy's attack, paralyzes and runs them through with the Chidori.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.0.desc:
A fireball straight at whoever you aim at (up to 44 blocks): stuns, burns and throws far.

Only a stun cuts the cast.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.1.desc:
Hold to charge (you can walk): longer hold, longer reach (8 to 22 blocks).

Release: you go through the target and nothing hits you on the way.

A stunned target or one marked by the Sharingan takes a crit.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.2.desc:
A fan of 9 lightning needles.

2 or more on the same target: 2.5 s paralysis. 1 needle: 1.5 s stun.

Combo: right after, Chidori (X) crits.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.3.desc:
Only under open sky. A giant bolt falls on the target (up to 64 blocks) and follows it: can't be dodged.

You can keep fighting while the clouds gather.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.4.desc:
For 6 s the first 2 hits on you miss. On the 2nd you appear behind them and kick.

Whoever you read is marked 4 s: Chidori crits and 1 needle from C already paralyzes.
power.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 7 (City). The ninja who copied a thousand techniques: a lightning hound, Kamui and the copying Sharingan.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.0.desc:
Press: dashes up to 16 blocks and launches the target, with a stun.

Hold: a lightning hound chases the target (24 blocks) and paralyzes it 2 s. A front guard blocks it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.1.desc:
Opens the Kamui on the target (or where you aim, 34 blocks).

Sucks everyone around (6 blocks) into the middle, stunned.

At the end they vanish into another dimension for 1 s and come back hurt.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.2.desc:
Copies the last skill used near you (24 blocks). It shows up on C for 15 s.

Press C: use it once, 20% stronger.

Divine Soul ults can't be copied.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.3.desc:
The Susanoo shields you: nothing hits or stuns you inside.

Throws two shuriken that chase the aimed target. Where they hit, the Kamui opens: it sucks in and hurts everything around (9 blocks), and whoever reaches the middle vanishes and comes back hurt.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.4.desc:
Trap (40 s) where you aim.

Whoever steps on it is bitten by 8 hounds and held 2.5 s, no moving or skills.

Combo: Raikiri (Z).
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.6.desc:
Counter for 1 s: hits from close pass through you.

Anything thrown from afar (shots, techniques) goes into the Kamui and comes back at whoever threw it, with a stun. Nothing stuns you meanwhile.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.8.desc: They say the Copy Ninja keeps a forbidden technique. Nobody who took it talks about it.
power.battlegroundsmod.gaara.desc: SubSoul of Naruto, Tier 7 (City). Real sand: it guards you on its own, grabs, crushes, carries you through the air and swallows a whole area.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.0.desc:
Press: a sand hand runs to the target (18 blocks) and throws it, with a stun.

Hold: it closes on the target and holds it.

Passive: the sand stops hits from the front until it is broken (a few Barrage hits). Broken, it is back in 15 s.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.1.desc:
Sand covers the target (24 blocks): held 2 s, no moving or skills.

Press X again: squeezes and bursts.

Reaches anyone in your Quicksand from any distance.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.2.desc:
Fly on a sand platform: aim steers, Space goes up, Shift goes down.

Uses stamina; without it you glide down.

Press C again: land.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.3.desc:
The aimed area (10 blocks) turns to quicksand and nobody gets out.

The sand closes into a dome and collapses: very high damage and a stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.4.desc:
Trap (40 s, up to 2): whoever steps in sinks, moves slowly, can't jump and is pulled to the middle for 4 s.

Combo: then X grabs them from afar.
power.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.desc: Naruto SubSoul, Tier 8 (Block). Lazy genius: his shadows hold on stamina and the paper bombs become his board. Whoever thinks wins.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.0.des:
The shadow runs to the target (24 blocks) and binds it, even bosses: it copies your steps for up to 4 s. Uses your stamina.

Press Z again and hold: strangles while held.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.1.des:
The shadow catches up to 4 enemies (20 blocks), pierces and holds them up to 4 s. Uses stamina.

Press X again: release.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.2.des:
Press: 1 paper bomb where you aim. Hold: a fan of up to 6.

They stay on the ground until they blow, up to 10 planted. They explode when an enemy steps on them.

Held by the shadow in 4 or more blasts: 3 s stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.3.des:
Thinks 1 s and the shadow binds everyone within 16 blocks.

A paper bomb climbs each of them and they blow up in a chain.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.4.des: For 8 s the shadows (Z and X) reach twice as far and use half the stamina.
power.battlegroundsmod.ino.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 8 (Block). The mind is the weapon: you drive the enemy's body, scramble his head and tie everyone's pain together. Passive, Mind Reading: when an enemy within 16 blocks starts a skill, a purple diamond pulses over his head and a thread ties your forehead to his (only you see it). Time to dodge.
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.0.desc:
Your spirit flies straight (20 blocks). Hit: you control the target's body for 3 s. Click with nobody in front: it punches itself (or cuts itself, with a blade in hand).

Press Z again: leave and hurt it.

Your body stays on the ground: if it gets hit, you come back dizzy.

Target with pollen (B): the spirit homes in.
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.1.desc: A wave in a cone (12 blocks): players get inverted controls for 4 s; mobs attack whoever is close. Alone, the target stumbles and hits itself.
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.2.desc:
Links up to 3 enemies for 6 s: half the damage one takes goes to the others. A single enemy: the thread goes to your mind and half of each blow echoes into him again.

The thread snaps past 12 blocks.
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.3.desc:
Everyone within 20 blocks is held 4 s, they hit each other (alone, themselves) and then blow up (high damage).

A strong hit on you ends it.
message.battlegroundsmod.ino.body_hit: Mind Transfer: your body was hit, the spirit came back!
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.4.desc:
Flowers where you aim (30 s, up to 2). Whoever steps in is marked and slowed for 8 s.

Combo: your next Shintenshin (Z) homes in on them.
message.battlegroundsmod.naruto.rendan_n: Uzumaki Combo: needs a target nearby.
message.battlegroundsmod.naruto.sage_bro: Sage Mode: your meditation was broken!
message.battlegroundsmod.naruto.sage_gro: Sage Mode: you need ground under you to meditate.
message.battlegroundsmod.naruto.fuuma_mi: Fuuma Shuriken: it hit no one.
message.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.nothing_: Sharingan: nobody attacked, nothing to read.
message.battlegroundsmod.gaara.shield_br: Sand Shield broken: back in %s s.
message.battlegroundsmod.gaara.grab_miss: Sand Hand: it didn't grab anyone.
message.battlegroundsmod.gaara.no_target: Sand Coffin: no target in sight.
message.battlegroundsmod.gaara.platform_: Sand Platform: out of stamina, the sand crumbles.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.no_ta: Shadow Possession: no target within the shadow's reach.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.too_h: Shadow Possession: too high up, its shadow doesn't reach the ground.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.escap: Shadow Possession: the target escaped the shadow.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.held: Shadow: that target is already held by another technique.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.out_o: Shadow: out of stamina, the shadow let go.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.no_ta: Paper bomb: the pouch is empty (1 back every %s s).
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.no_ar: Paper bomb: no armed paper to set off.
message.battlegroundsmod.ino.wave_miss: Mind Disturbance: nobody was caught by the wave.
message.battlegroundsmod.ino.link_few: Mind Link: no enemy in front.
message.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.nothing: Sharingan empty: watch someone use a skill.
message.battlegroundsmod.kame.suiken_dod: The Drunken Fist dodged your blow.
message.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.taiyoke: Your back was to the Taiyoken.
Taiyoken: %s blinded, %s had their back turned.
message.battlegroundsmod.todo.hold_mark: %s marked. Aim at another and let go.
power.battlegroundsmod.itadori.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 6 (Continental). The strongest body of the SubAlmas. Passive Monstrous Body: base punches 15% stronger, and every blow you land fills your Rhythm (it drains after 5 s without hitting): the more Rhythm, the wider the Black Flash window.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.0.desc:
Three punches; the last one hits again a moment later, with a stun. Breaks guard.

Hold: keep that second hit. Release to blow it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.1.desc:
A ring closes on your fist. Press X again right as it closes: Black Flash (high damage and stun).

Landing hits before makes the window bigger.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.2.desc:
1 s guard.

Hit from the front: caught and answered with a kick that stuns.

Projectile from the front: sent back to the thrower.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.3.desc:
Mark up to 3 things (enemy, pillar, wall).

Press V again, or wait 3 s: cuts them all. Pillars fall and enemies are stunned.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.4.desc:
On someone using or charging a power: cuts the move, stuns and leaves them powerless for 3 s.

On someone idle it is just a punch.
power.battlegroundsmod.choso.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 6 (Continental). Real Blood Manipulation: the piercing line, the orbs, the binding, Maximum Piercing and the Meteorite. Every blow of blood that lands leaves a pool on the ground for 10 s: a trap for the Supernova and the Meteorite.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.0.desc:
Hold to compress (up to 2 s) and release: a 25 block jet of blood that pierces everyone.

The jet lasts up to 2 s and follows your aim: sweep it across targets.

More charge, stronger and longer.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.1.desc:
5 orbs spin around you and each blocks one hit.

Press X again (or wait 8 s): the rest burst into needles along with your puddles.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.2.desc:
A blood rope (12 blocks) ties the target for 2.5 s, no moving or skills. A front guard blocks it.

Press C again: pulls it to you.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.3.desc:
Charges 2 s standing still and fires a giant 40 block Piercing Blood in a sweep.

At the end the trail explodes, with a stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.4.desc:
A ball of blood thrown in an arc that crushes where it lands, with a stun.

Near one of your puddles, the puddle bursts into needles.
power.battlegroundsmod.nanami.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 7 (City). The Ratio Technique: the 7:3 point of anything becomes a critical hit. On the clock: after 1 minute of fighting, every hit of his lands 20% harder (it doesn't stack with Overtime).
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.0.desc:
Measures the target: the ruler shows up on them with the 7:3 point (3 s).

Press Z again: dash in and hit the point. Crit with double damage and a 2 s stun.

With the cleaver in hand, a plain click marks too.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.1.desc:
Punches the 7:3 point of a wall: it cracks from bottom to top and falls forward, burying whoever is under it.

On the ground: the crack runs 12 blocks and the ground sinks behind it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.2.desc:
Three crits in a row on the 7:3 point.

The cloth snaps on every hit and comes loose on the last, which throws far.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.3.desc:
Wraps the tie round his fist: 12 s of heavier hits and everyone near is marked with the 7:3.

Press V again: leaps and sinks the area with a punch.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.4.desc: 1.2 s guard: whoever hits you misses and takes a crit with a 2 s stun.
power.battlegroundsmod.nobara.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 8 (Block). Straw Doll Technique: every nail carries cursed energy. Passive Nail In: a nail stays in someone 10 s (up to 3), and Hairpin and Resonance hit harder for each one. One of the mod's biggest stunners.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.0.desc:
Throws 3 nails (up to 25 blocks). Those that hit stay in 10 s; those that miss stay in the ground.

With a nail in someone, Z again: every nail bursts and stuns.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.1.desc:
Hurts everyone with your nail or blood, up to 60 blocks: high damage (more per nail) and a 2 s stun.

Costs a bit of your life.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.2.desc:
Up close: hammers a nail into the target's chest, 1.5 s stun.

The nail counts for Resonance (X).
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.3.desc:
For 8 s the damage you take goes back to everyone with your nail or blood.

At the end, a giant Resonance on them and a 3 s stun.

Costs life.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.4.desc:
Hammers a trail of 10 nails into the ground where you aim. They stay until used (up to 12). Whoever steps on one gets a nail in the foot.

B again: every loose nail flies at the nearest marked one. Then Hairpin (Z).
power.battlegroundsmod.todo.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 6 (Continental). Boogie Woogie: one clap and everything swaps places. Whoever he swaps is lost for a moment: the next hit on them is a critical.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.0.desc:
Press: swap places with whoever you aim at (25 blocks), a person or one of your stones.

Hold: mark one, aim at another and release; the two swap (a stone with an enemy too).

Whoever is swapped is lost: your next hit on them crits.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.1.desc:
Jump and punch the ground: a crater, and the earth flies out in stones of every size that stay on the ground.

The stones are yours: all your skills use them.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.2.desc: Fake clap: everyone near gets a short stun and your next hit on them crits.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.3.desc:
Needs one of your stones next to you.

1st V: throw the stone about 15 blocks up.
2nd V at the target before it falls: they swap, the target drops and you go up punching. Black Flash.

No 2nd V in time: the stone smashes and the ult ends.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.4.desc:
Needs one of your stones next to you.

Kick the stone at the enemy (up to 30 blocks). Close to them, swap with it in the air and arrive punching.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.8.desc:
With the ult bar full: a dash of up to 50 blocks along your aim, nothing stops you.

Touched someone: guaranteed Black Flash, 2.5 s stun.

Missed: the ult is lost.
power.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 7 (City). Cursed Speech: the collar comes down, the snake mark lights up and every word is an order that truly stuns. Every word strains his throat; past the limit he coughs blood and can't speak for 4 s.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.0.desc:
"Stop": whoever you look at (15 blocks) is stunned 1.5 s. Hold to keep it a bit longer.

Combo: right after, X.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.1.desc:
"Get crushed": high damage and stun. The target is pressed flat like a sheet of paper in the hole until the stun ends.

Crits on a target stopped by "Stop". Finishing, it becomes a pool of blood.

Strains the throat a lot.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.2.desc: "Sleep": whoever you look at (8 blocks) is slow and tired for 2 s, staggering.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.3.desc:
"Blow away": a 30 block cone that rips the ground up and throws everyone VERY far, breaking whatever is in the way.

Finishing: gone over the horizon. Looking up at a target above you: it becomes a star in the sky.

Bursts the throat (4 s silent) unless it was empty.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.4.desc:
For 6 s your next word (Z, X, C or Shift+V) hits everyone in a 25 block cone.

Strains the throat more.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.8.desc:
"Explode": the target swells from inside and bursts. Very high damage and a 2.5 s stun; finishing, the body is gone in the burst.

Uses the whole throat: 6 s silent.
power.battlegroundsmod.miwa.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 8 (Block). New Shadow Style: the swordswoman of patience and the counter. Calm Sheath: every second without attacking fills 1 of 3 marks (+15% each), spent by the next cut.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.0.desc:
Hold: a ring closes on the ground around you. Let go when it touches the inner one: Perfect Batto, a 7 block cut, 1.5 s stun, no cooldown and 3 s off the others.

Out of time: a 4 block cut.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.1.desc:
Comes out at once, no lock. A 4 block circle for 8 s: with you inside, whoever steps in is cut and thrown out (up to 3), shots are cut and a Domain Expansion can't catch you.

Inside it the Batto ring closes twice as fast and the Split Moon doubles. Beams from outside go through with half damage.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.2.desc:
Crosses 8 blocks through the target.

The cut opens a moment later, with a stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.3.desc:
The circle opens (12 blocks, 24 inside the Simple Domain) and marks everyone inside at once, and whoever comes in later.

Press V again (or wait 5 s): one single cut hits everyone marked, 3 s stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.4.desc:
1.2 s window: whoever hits you misses, you appear behind them cutting, 2 s stun.

If nobody hits, you are exposed for a moment.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.miss: Nobody in reach of the blow.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.bf_earl: Too early! The ring had not closed yet.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.bf_late: Too late! The ring had already closed.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.zone: In the zone! Black Flash %s of 2.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.alma: Soul knocked out! No power for %s s.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.alma_va: They were not using any power: just a punch.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.tesoura: Nothing in reach of your palm to mark.
message.battlegroundsmod.nanami.miss: Nobody in reach of the blade.
message.battlegroundsmod.nanami.not_yet: Still on the clock: %s s of fighting left before Overtime.
message.battlegroundsmod.nobara.no_link: Nobody with your nail or your blood for the Resonance.
message.battlegroundsmod.nobara.too_far: You need to be right on the target.
message.battlegroundsmod.todo.no_target: Aim at someone to swap places.
message.battlegroundsmod.todo.nobody: Nobody near to fall for the fake clap.
message.battlegroundsmod.todo.sem_pedra: None of your stones next to you. Use X (Ground Breaker) first.
message.battlegroundsmod.todo.bf_espera: V again aiming at the target! The stone lands in %s s.
message.battlegroundsmod.todo.bf_perdeu: The stone landed first: no Black Flash.
message.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.silence: The throat gave out: no speaking for 4 s.
message.battlegroundsmod.miwa.marks: Calm Sheath: %s marks in the cut.
power.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.desc: Upper Moon One. Every cut of Moon Breathing fills the air with moons. Oni: strong regeneration (swords and destruction stop it for 5 s), 1.5x stronger at night, more at the full moon, weaker and slower to heal under the sun. The H key stretches the sword: Z, X, C, B and V become the 7th, 8th, 9th, 10th and 14th Forms, and Shift+V the 16th. Every cut and every moon lands as a blow of its own.
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.0.de:
A quick arc slash in front of you, with moons that also hit.

Short cooldown: your everyday move.
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.1.de:
Jumps and three slashes spin around you, firing moons outward. Whoever gets close is cut and thrown.

Counter: usable while being comboed, but not when stunned by a technique.
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.2.de:
Two giant slashes along the ground, out and back, with a rain of moons over the area.

Good against spread out enemies.
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.3.de:
Dozens of moons in a burst ahead, each on its own curve.

Hard to dodge and destroys everything in the way.
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.4.de:
A hurricane of slashes spins around you: whoever gets close is cut and thrown.

Counter: usable while being comboed, but not when stunned by a technique.
message.battlegroundsmod.vazio_relampago: No one close enough for the 0.2-second Domain Expansion.
The 0.2-second Domain Expansion does nothing inside or against a Domain: only your real Expansion (V) holds off the Shrine.
Caught charging! 0.2-second Domain Expansion: brain damage and out of stamina.
0.2-second Domain Expansion: technique broken, brain damage.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.8.des:
Counter. Breaks everyone's technique in the area, even a Domain opening.

Locks them all: 5 s on players, 3 s on bosses and mobs. Whoever was using a skill loses all stamina.

With nobody near, it doesn't go off.
fala.battlegroundsmod.gojo.fugindo: Where do you think you're going?
fala.battlegroundsmod.bills.atordoado: Hold still. This will be quick.
fala.battlegroundsmod.bills.fome: I'm getting hungry... let's finish this.
fala.battlegroundsmod.bills.pouca_vida: Now you've really made me angry...
fala.battlegroundsmod.bills.inevitavel: Do you really think you can face me with that level of power? Pathetic.
fala.battlegroundsmod.bills.inevitavel_f: Know this: the God of Destruction is inevitable.
fala.battlegroundsmod.aizen.kyoka: Since when were you under the impression I was there?
fala.battlegroundsmod.aizen.dedo: Don't use such strong words, it makes you look weak.
fala.battlegroundsmod.aizen.inicio: From now on, I will stand in the heavens.
fala.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.fuga: Arm yourself. Use your best move to defend against this.
fala.battlegroundsmod.aizen.hogyoku: No one stands at the top from the start.
message.battlegroundsmod.moon_sword.off: The sword is back to normal
ability.battlegroundsmod.moon_demon.8.de:
Only with the stretched sword (H).

Six giant slashes fall from the sky on anyone within 50 blocks, one per enemy. No aiming needed.
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.desperta: All you did... was tear my kimono off.
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.pouca_vi: What a hideous form... is this?
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.bebe: Not even an infant would die from that...
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.dois: If I kill the two of you... everyone else will be defeated easily.
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.dificil: I must admit... your movements are hard to read.
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.trezento: I haven't seen anyone like you in 300 years...
fala.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.inicio: I shall draw my sword... it would be rude of me not to.
power.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.desc: Ryomen Sukuna, the King of Curses. His techniques arrive one by one: Dismantle on Z (combo, chant and the World Cutting Slash), cuts on the opponent on Shift+Z, Cleave on X, Fuga on C, the Domain Expansion (Malevolent Shrine) on V and the Slam on B.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.0.desc:
Press: a flying slash. 3 presses in a row make a combo.

Hold: the chant, up to 3 words, each stronger. Getting hit breaks it.

Model bar full: the World Cutting Slash comes out. Ignores defense and stuns.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.1.desc:
Runs up to 30 blocks and grabs the neck: cuts and a throw. Damage grows with the target's max life.

The target lands stunned for 2 s.

Combo: right after, Fuga (C).
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.2.desc:
Only on a stunned or exhausted target (use X first). Reaches 64 blocks.

The target is held in place while the arrow forms. You stand still charging.

Explodes in 20 blocks and sets fire up to 28.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.3.desc:
Domain: stops attacks in the air up to 40 blocks and paralyzes whoever it catches (stamina lets you resist).

For 30 s the cuts hit everyone but you.

Press V again: closes it. V twice: opens fast, no cutscene.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.4.desc:
Runs up to 24 blocks.

If it lands: launches the target, slams it down and stomps. The web of cuts hits everyone around (up to 13 blocks) and blows them up.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.5.desc:
Opens your hand at the target (up to 48 blocks): 20 cuts appear on its body, each one a jolt. The last throws it far.

You stand still while cutting.
fala.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.canto3: 番いの流星 Paired Falling Stars
fala.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.inicio_gojo: You're just a fish on my cutting board...
fala.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.matou_gojo: You were magnificent. I will never forget you as long as I live.
message.battlegroundsmod.mundo_souls: Souls world: missions and progression on.
message.battlegroundsmod.mundo_livre: Free world (downloaded map): every skill open, no missions or progression.
screen.battlegroundsmod.challenges.go: Click to go to the arena
screen.battlegroundsmod.challenges.hint: Winning makes the character spawn often in its universe (before, only now and then)
message.battlegroundsmod.arena_missing: The arena dimension did not load. Create a new world or check the datapacks.
message.battlegroundsmod.arena_taken: Someone is already fighting in that arena.
message.battlegroundsmod.arena_no_entity: This character has no mob in the game yet: %s
message.battlegroundsmod.arena_unlocked: %s now spawns in the world. Going back in %s s.
message.battlegroundsmod.arena_again: You beat %s again. Going back in %s s.
message.battlegroundsmod.arena_lost: %s won this one. Try again from the book.
screen.battlegroundsmod.challenges.locke: Beat %s SubAlmas of this universe to open
You start human, Tier 10, with the chosen universe's Book of Challenges.
screen.battlegroundsmod.universes.travel: Choose the universe. The crystal is spent on the trip.
screen.battlegroundsmod.universes.count: %s characters in the Book of Challenges
message.battlegroundsmod.universe_born: Your universe. Open the Book of Challenges.
message.battlegroundsmod.universe_need_c: Hold a Multiversal Crystal to travel.
message.battlegroundsmod.universe_missin: Universe %s doesn't exist in this world (created before the mod?).
message.battlegroundsmod.universe_off: No universes in a flat world or with soulsProgressao off.
item.battlegroundsmod.cristal_multiversa: Takes you to another universe. Spent on the trip.
message.battlegroundsmod.book_locked: In this world souls come from the characters you beat.
item.battlegroundsmod.senzu.desc: Heals everything, fills hunger and stamina. 30 s recharge.
item.battlegroundsmod.scouter.desc: Worn: reads the power level of whoever you aim at, up to 64 blocks. Y scans around.
item.battlegroundsmod.radar_dragao.desc: Hold it: the screen shows the Dragon Balls around. Right click: zoom.
item.battlegroundsmod.esfera_dragao.desc: Gather all 7 and click to call the Eternal Dragon.
message.battlegroundsmod.radar_all: You have all 7 Dragon Balls! Click one.
message.battlegroundsmod.esferas_liberad: Every Dragon Ball star can drop again.
message.battlegroundsmod.esfera_virou_pe: Your %s-star Dragon Ball turned to stone: a newer one already appeared in the world.
message.battlegroundsmod.shenlong_ask: Eternal Dragon: I will grant one wish. Choose (click):
message.battlegroundsmod.wish.poder.desc: Fills your tier's bar at once
message.battlegroundsmod.wish.alma.desc: The soul of a Dragon Ball character you already beat in the arena
message.battlegroundsmod.wish.rival.desc: The next character of the book comes down to fight you right here
message.battlegroundsmod.wish.imortal.de: 10 minutes of regeneration and resistance, and dying takes no Poder
message.battlegroundsmod.wish_none: There is no wish to make.
message.battlegroundsmod.shenlong_done: Eternal Dragon: Your wish has been granted. Farewell!
message.battlegroundsmod.flight_disabled: Flying is turned off in this world.
message.battlegroundsmod.flight_tired: No energy to fly: eat something.
message.battlegroundsmod.flight_tired_st: Out of breath: gliding down to land. Standing still in the air or on the ground brings it back.
message.battlegroundsmod.flight_lock.fre: Freeza's aura won't let you fly.
message.battlegroundsmod.flight_lock.has: The God of Shinobi's chakra holds you to the ground.
message.battlegroundsmod.air_reflect: Perfect guard: the ki ball goes back!
npc.battlegroundsmod.gohan.weak: Want to learn to fly? Get a little stronger first. Come back at Tier 9.
npc.battlegroundsmod.gohan.teach: Gather your ki under your body and let it out slowly... That's it! Jump twice and you fly. Careful: flying makes you hungry.
npc.battlegroundsmod.gohan.after.0: Flying is tiring. Bring food, or a Senzu.
npc.battlegroundsmod.gohan.after.1: The Sacred Cat gives a Senzu a day. Don't forget to visit him.
npc.battlegroundsmod.gohan.after.2: Saibamen look weak, but they come in packs.
npc.battlegroundsmod.korin.senzu: Here, a Senzu Bean. Come back tomorrow for another.
npc.battlegroundsmod.korin.hint.0: I already gave you today's Senzu. Come back tomorrow.
npc.battlegroundsmod.korin.hint.1: They say the 7 Dragon Balls lie scattered across this world. A Radar would help...
npc.battlegroundsmod.korin.hint.2: Frieza's soldiers wear Scouters. Take one.
npc.battlegroundsmod.korin.hint.3: Beerus only fights those who beat some warriors of this universe.
npc.battlegroundsmod.korin.hint.4: The Saiyan's Son teaches flight to whoever is strong enough.
item.battlegroundsmod.kunai_hiraishin.de: Shift + click: marks the spot. Click: flash back to the mark (up to 300 blocks).
item.battlegroundsmod.pilula_soldado.des: Full stamina, strength and speed for 30 s. Hunger afterwards.
item.battlegroundsmod.ramen.desc: A full meal that keeps healing.
item.battlegroundsmod.gunbai.desc: Madara's war fan. On guard it takes the hits before you and steals 1% stamina from whoever strikes. Broken: 60 s to come back.
item.battlegroundsmod.shuriken.desc: Right click throws. Fast and light; it drops where it hit to be picked up.
item.battlegroundsmod.kunai.desc: A quick knife in the hand. Right click throws, harder than the shuriken.

power.battlegroundsmod.makima.desc: Makima, the Control Devil. Not strong or destructive: she controls, manipulates and makes others fight for her. Bang on Z, Chain on X, Order on Shift+X, Puppet on C, Rats on Shift+C, the Souls on V and the Ritual of Names on B. Passive Prime Minister: every blow on her closes in 1 s and the price comes out of her puppets' life, then her stamina (while it's on, her hits don't give stamina back; at the red it rests 60 s). With neither, the blow stays with her. Bang, Chain and Order cost no stamina.
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.0.desc:
Press: shoots whoever you aim at (fires 0.55 s later). Damage and push.

Hold: locks up to 3 targets and fires one after another.

A target at 15% life or less bursts.
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.1.desc:
A chain holds the target on its knees: 2.5 s stun and drains stamina.

Combo: right after, "Die" (Shift+X).
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.2.desc:
Mobs you kill become stored puppets (up to 9).

Press C: release one to fight for you (up to 3 out).

Hold C: panel to release, recall and give orders.

Puppets pay for the hits you take.
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.3.desc:
Souls you killed come back and fight with their own kit for 40 s (up to 2).

Press V again: "Die." and they execute their targets.

No souls: chains bind everyone around. V again squeezes until they burst.
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.4.desc:
Write the name of someone you have seen. Each puppet out crushes the target with it, up to 60 blocks and through walls.

1 puppet kneels them, 2 put them on all fours, 3 kill.

No puppets: costs 20% of your life, one hit.
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.6.desc:
An order to whoever you look at, based on their state. They all stun.

Far: "Come". Close: "Kneel". Close and weaker: "Woof".

At 20% life or less and stunned (or exhausted): "Die".
ability.battlegroundsmod.makima.7.desc:
8 rats appear around and you see enemies through walls.

Press Shift+C again: you appear next to the rat you are looking at.

Whatever he touches with all five fingers dries, cracks and turns to dust, and the Decay spreads through whatever is touching it. Touch on Z, Sonic Scream on X, Hands from the Ground on C, Hand Tentacles on V, Absorb on B, Regeneration on Shift+Z and End of the World on Shift+V.

power.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.desc: Hashirama Senju, the God of Shinobi. Boss only: his Wood Release grows forests, stakes, prisons, lances, flowers that put you to sleep, a dome that strikes back and the Wood Dragon; in Sage Mode he raises the Buddha of a Thousand Hands.
message.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.alvo_: That target is already held by another technique.
ability.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.0.des: A wave of trees bursts out of the ground towards the target and throws whoever it meets.
ability.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.1.des: A front of stakes runs under the ground after the target; the ground swells 0.32 s before each fan. At the end, a flower of 11 thick stakes.
ability.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.2.des: 0.9 s of a square crack on the ground (the warning), then four pillars and beams close round the target for 3 s or 3 hits.
ability.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.3.des: The ult. The ground cracks and shakes, the dragon bursts out, spirals up, roars and hunts the target, turning slowly. Caught: it coils, drinks stamina and slams.
ability.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.4.des: The arm turns to wood (the warning) and the lance opens into 6 branches that close where the target stood.
ability.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.5.des: Nine giant flowers sprout round the target. Open, their pollen fills a sleep bar; asleep, a stake throws you. Leave while they are still closed.
ability.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.6.des: A dome of woven wood guards him. Hit it: it creaks 0.4 s and throws 9 stakes at your side. After 2.6 s it opens.
ability.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.7.des: A giant wooden golem rises waist-deep from the ground. For 15 s it punches (the shadow warns you) and sweeps the ground to grab. Block the grab and the hand bounces back.
ability.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.8.des: Sage Mode: the wooden Buddha rises from the ground and he stands on its head. The fan's hands slap the ground (0.75 s shadows) and the Top Strike drops one giant palm.
ability.battlegroundsmod.hashirama.9.des: His body turns to wood and bursts into splinters. He shows up behind the target and a stake bursts from the ground right after.
power.battlegroundsmod.freeza_total.desc: Freeza at 100%. Boss only power: a homing Double Kienzan, a piece of Namek thrown, the Death Volley fan, the Tail Blitz and the Imperial Wave; at 100% Namek falls apart (red sky, lava geysers, a 5:00 clock) and ki rains down until the Death Ball.
item.battlegroundsmod.freeza_total_spawn: Emperor at Full Power Spawn Egg
fala.battlegroundsmod.freeza_total.inici: I'll show you only 50% of my power. That's already more than you deserve.
fala.battlegroundsmod.freeza_total.poder: Now... 100%! This planet explodes in five minutes!
fala.battlegroundsmod.freeza_total.super: I'll wipe you out along with this planet!
fala.battlegroundsmod.freeza_total.cansa: My body... can't take this power...
fala.battlegroundsmod.freeza_total.esgot: Impossible... I am the emperor of the universe!
A saw disc spins up on each hand (0.75 s) and both home in. Jump over them at the last instant and stick to him: the disc coming back cuts Freeza himself (12% of his life, stunned 3 s).
The ground cracks in a circle, a whole piece of it is torn out and rises; a shadow grows where it will fall (0.9 s): 40. Hit the island in the air with any blow and it bursts into rocks (only 8).
Six aim lines fan out on the ground (0.45 s blinking, then locked) and six Death Beams fire along them (22 each). Stop in a gap between the lines.
Only at 100%. He rises and fires 30 ki balls, each with a red reticle closing where it lands (12, no knockback); then the Death Ball, with a 5.5 block shadow growing for 1.2 s (55).
He vanishes; a purple circle closes behind you with his shimmer (0.35 s). Tail whip (16) and axe kick (24). Dash aside during the shimmer: his back is open for 1.5 s.
For whoever stays glued to him hitting: a 6.4 block ring of cracks lights up (0.6 s) and a dome tears up the ground (26 and thrown). Get out of the ring.
At half his life: muscles, a little red ball into the ground and Namek starts to fall apart. Red sky, lava cracks and geysers round the arena (an orange circle 0.8 s before). His power falls with the 5:00 clock.

challenge.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.foco: Tricks. The Destructo Disc cuts through anything and the Solar Flare blinds. Weak up close, dangerous from afar.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.foco: Control. The Special Beam Cannon pierces, the stretching arm pulls and the Hellzone Grenade surrounds you.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.kame.foco: Sealing. The Mafuba traps the target in the jar and the Drunken Fist dodges everything.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.goku.foco: Balance. Kamehameha, teleporting behind you, Kaioken and the Spirit Bomb.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.foco: Explosions. Barrages that cover the target in smoke, Big Bang and Final Flash.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.freeza.foco: Precision. Fast Death Beam, telekinesis, Death Saucer and Supernova.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.bills.foco: Destruction. Hakai erases whoever is weak. This universe's god.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.foc: Binding. His shadow holds you in place.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.ino.foco: Mind. Gets into your head and swaps bodies.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.foco: Technique. Raikiri and jutsu copied with the Sharingan.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.gaara.foco: Defense. The sand blocks everything and crushes whoever gets close.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.foco: Speed. Chidori, and the Sharingan dodges your blows.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.madara.foco: War. Fire Release, Susanoo and the Meteor. This universe's god.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.nobara.foco: Resonance. Nails and a hammer that hurt from a distance.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.miwa.foco: Counterattack. Her Batto cuts whoever steps into her Simple Domain.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.nanami.foco: 7:3 Ratio. Every cut looks for your weak point.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.foco: Cursed Speech. One word and you stop.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.itadori.foco: Close combat. Divergent Fist and Black Flash.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.choso.foco: Blood. Pierces from afar and pins you down.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.todo.foco: Swapping places. One clap and you don't know where you are anymore.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.gojo.foco: Infinity. Blue, Red, Purple and the Domain Expansion. The strongest.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.sukuna.foco: Slashes. Dismantle, Cleave and the Shrine. The King of Curses.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.rukia.foco: Ice. Freezes you and the ground around you.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.foco: Petals. The thousand blades of Senbonzakura.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.kokushibo.foc: Moons. Moon Breathing cuts in a fan. Upper Moon One.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.shigaraki.foc: Decay. Everything his hand touches turns to dust, even the ground. Don't let him touch you.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.joy_boy.foco: Gear 5. Rubber, laughter and the scenery turning into a cartoon. When he gets tired and hungry, that's your chance.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.makima.foco: Control. She fights from afar and makes others fight for her. Close the distance.
challenge.battlegroundsmod.saitama.foco: One punch. He plays around until he gets serious. When he does, don't be in front of him.

caminho.battlegroundsmod.kame.chegada: Hm? A visitor? Ho ho! I'd be happier if you were a pretty girl, but come in.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kame.lugar: The Kame House, of course. It's the world out there that changed. A while ago the sky cracked, and now there are ninjas jumping between trees and cursed things around the cities. I stay here on my island.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kame.almas: When someone truly strong falls, their soul stays. Take it and you fight like them. But a fighter's soul in a weak body won't last. That's why you train.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kame.lutar: Ho ho, that's what I like to hear! Put this shell on your back and go deliver the milk. On foot, no flying, no crying.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kame.passou: Ka... me... ha... me... HA! There, it's yours. Swap souls all you want, this one stays. And on foot you'll take fifty years to get anywhere. Go to Goku's house in the mountains, the Saiyan's Son will teach you to fly.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kame.voo: Still walking? Go to Goku's house in the mountains. The Saiyan's Son will teach you to fly.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.gohan.dragonbal: That's it! Now that you can fly, stop by Capsule Corp. The Capsule Heiress is looking for someone to hunt Dragon Balls.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.gohan.naruto: That's it! Now go back to the Copy Ninja, he must be waiting for you.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.gohan.jujutsu: That's it! Now go back to the Principal, he must be waiting for you.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.bulma.radar: You're the old man's new student? Here's the radar, the dots are the balls. And this Scouter... wow, your power level is a joke. Find a ball, then win a couple in the Book of Challenges.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.bulma.esfera: You have the radar. Follow the dots.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.bulma.livro: Found one? Now open the Book of Challenges and win a couple before you go anywhere.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.bulma.karin: Better. To really get stronger, go to Korin Tower. And climb it, the Sacred Cat is picky about that.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.korin.sala: You climbed? Good. Drink the water. The Time Chamber is up top, go in.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.korin.freeza: After the Time Chamber there's only the Emperor of the Universe left, and he's in your Book. Good luck, you'll need it.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.chegada: Yo. My first impression of you? I'll tell you later.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.lugar: The Leaf Village. At least it was. After the sky cracked, a desert that isn't ours showed up, an island with an old man in a shell, and a city full of curses. We're getting used to it.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.energia: Chakra. Body and spirit together. Control it well and you stand on water and run up trees. Don't, and you fall on your face.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.treina: See the post in the middle of the field? There's a bell on it. Grab it and hold it for sixty seconds. Fail and you skip lunch.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.passou: Hm. You passed. Ninjas don't fly, but there's a kid from another world who does, the Saiyan's Son, and he teaches it. When you're back I'll tell you about someone I know.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.voo: Still here? Go find the Saiyan's Son, the kid who flies. He lives in a house in the mountains.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.jiraiya: Flying, huh? Never seen that before. Go to Mount Myoboku and look for the Toad Sage. A bit of a pervert, but there's no better teacher.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.jiraiya.chegada: Hey, hey! You scared the girls... I mean, you interrupted my research! Since you're here, listen up: I am the great Toad Sage of Mount Myoboku!
caminho.battlegroundsmod.jiraiya.livro: A Rasengan that only popped balloons is a decoration. Open the Book of Challenges and beat two ninjas.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.jiraiya.sabio: Now stay still and feel nature coming in. Crouch still for a few seconds and it comes. Move and you lose it all.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.jiraiya.madara: There's a name even I avoid saying. Madara Uchiha, the Ghost of the Uchiha. He's in your Book. Come back alive, I still want to write about you.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.chegada: Sit. Gojo told me about you, and I don't trust what Gojo says. So I'll ask myself: why do you want to be a sorcerer?
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.hm: Hm. Let's see if you believe that.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.denovo: Again. Hold them off this time.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.meio: Sorcerers die. Sometimes alone, sometimes somewhere awful. Hold on.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.falhou: Couldn't take it? Talk to me again when you're ready.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.passou: Fine. That'll do. Take the doll, it fights at your side. Before hunting curses, learn to fly. There's a kid from another world, the Saiyan's Son. Then come back.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.pergunta: Ask what you want. Make it quick.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.lugar: The school's temple. Since the sky cracked, people from three worlds are scared at the same time. Fear turns into curses. Do the math.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.maldicoes: Fear, hate, regret. That turns into energy, and piled-up energy turns into a curse. Only cursed energy can exorcise one.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.voo: Learn to fly with the Saiyan's Son first. Then we talk about curses.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.aldeia: The Cursed Village. Exorcise ten and come back in one piece.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.agora: Do what I told you and come back in one piece.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.shoko: Back in one piece. The Healer wants to see you.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.yaga.sukuna: Enough preparing. The King of Curses is in your Book. Nobody comes back from him the same.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.shoko.chegada: You're the new one? Try not to get hurt too much, I'm tired.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.shoko.maki: The Weapon Master is training in Kyoto Autumn. She has no cursed energy at all and hits harder than most sorcerers. Take a beating from her, it'll do you good.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.maki.chegada: The principal sent you? Here, the Playful Cloud. A three-section staff, hits harder than it looks. Now go get beaten by people with techniques: two challenges in the Book, then we talk.
caminho.battlegroundsmod.maki.livro: Two challenges in the Book. Then we talk.

intro.battlegroundsmod.say.dica3: Beat the ones in the Book of Challenges and they show up in the world.
intro.battlegroundsmod.say.dica4: Every universe has a master. Worth finding them.
intro.battlegroundsmod.say.coincidencia: Well, what a coincidence running into you here.
intro.battlegroundsmod.say.so_eu: The masters teach you a lot. This one, only I do.

power.battlegroundsmod.toji.desc: Toji Fushiguro, the Sorcerer Killer. Boss only: no cursed energy at all, just speed and strength, with the Inverted Spear and the Playful Cloud. All of Shibuya comes down.
ability.battlegroundsmod.toji.0.desc: He's gone, bouncing 6 times over the roofs around you, each landing a crater. The 7th is at your back: the kick splits the buildings in a line of 120.
ability.battlegroundsmod.toji.1.desc: A three-hit combo. The spin cuts the top off everything within 64 (don't jump), the slam opens a furrow of 100 and the typhoon pulls everything in and lets go in a crater of 30.
ability.battlegroundsmod.toji.2.desc: He spins the spear on its chain around himself out to 60 blocks, like a fan. Everything turns to stumps at the chain's height. Jump the chain, stick to him or get out of reach.
ability.battlegroundsmod.toji.3.desc: Under 25%. He runs the avenue in 0.7 s, leaps 70 blocks and comes down spear first: a crater of 32 and the buildings around topple whole. His shadow shows where.
ability.battlegroundsmod.toji.4.desc: An expansion around him shatters. The thrust cuts the target's technique (sealed for 2.5 s) and opens a corridor of 140.
